name: Gerard Tiller
summary: At the Maclure Vineyards, Gerard Tiller tends the grounds and longs for spring water. Bring him a skin of it, and he offers shiny red apples.

sections.title: A Thirsty Farmhand
sections.body: Gerard Tiller works outside the barn at the Maclure Vineyards, south of Goldshire. The vineyard is known for its grapes, and keeping the harvest going takes hard labor. His chores leave him thirsty, so he welcomes travelers who bring a skin of fresh spring water. In return, he gives them shiny red apples gathered from local orchards.

faq.answer: Gerard Tiller is a human farmhand who works outside the barn at the Maclure Vineyards in southern Elwynn Forest.

faq.q: Where can I find Gerard Tiller?
faq.answer: Look outside the large wooden barn at the Maclure Vineyards, south of Goldshire and east of the Stonefield Farm.
Gerard trades a Shiny Red Apple for a skin of Refreshing Spring Water.

faq.q: Does Gerard get involved in the Maclure and Stonefield feud?
faq.answer: No. Gerard works at the Maclure Vineyards and tends to his chores and thirst, apart from the rivalry between the Maclures and Stonefields.

angles.text: Gerard trades fresh apples for plain spring water, giving travelers who want simple ingredients a source of fruit.
